gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
The ink ___ off after the first wash.
gaps.explanation: 'Come off' = become removed, especially by washing.

gaps.sentence: Who will take ___ from the current director?
gaps.explanation: take over = take control of a job/company.

gaps.sentence: The plane takes ___ in ten minutes.
gaps.explanation: take off = leave the ground (plane); also remove clothes; become successful (career took off).

gaps.sentence: Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
The match was called ___ because of the storm.
It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.
